utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can keep spreading the word and point folks toward the repair drive supplies—what needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Jules—what we need most right now is a few more basic hand tools and extension cords. If you can point folks to those, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word for basic hand tools and extension cords and point folks your way if they can help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds helpful, Sam. Could you bring a few basic tools and help set things up around 9?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies, and I’ll mention the basic tools and setup around 9 too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that’s a clear help. Let’s stick with 9 and keep the word going.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first. Let me know if anything else needs adding to the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, but how many stops are we doing in total? I still need the full route before I can plan the drive time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet — I only have the first stops so far. Let me check the full route and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping the details organized, so if you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I can help spread the word, but I still need the route and total stops to gauge the drive time. Do you know how many stops we’re planning?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I don’t have the stop count yet, Pia, but I’ll confirm it and send it over soon. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. We need help getting the word out and sorting the repair list most of all.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help spread the word and take a quick look at the repair list too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — that would really help. I’ll send you the latest list so you can take a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just let me know the timing and what I should bring or do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — if you send me the time, I can work around school pickup and drop-off. I’ll also let you know what to bring once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — I’ll send you the time soon. Thanks for coordinating around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s looking busy again—people are still dropping off tools and spare parts for the repair drive. I’ll let you know if anything urgent comes up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. Keep me posted if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—thanks, Leo. I’ll let you know if anything urgent comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I’ll pass it along that the repair drive is coming up and that supplies are welcome if folks can help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, just let me know what supplies are most needed and when to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check the list and get back to you with the most needed supplies and drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just remind me what’s needed and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — what we need most right now is repair supplies and a few extra hands to sort them. I’ll send over the updated list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great — send it over when you can, and I’ll check my shed for anything useful too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center sounds much better. What kinds of repairs are they focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the repair-drive details yet, so I want to check before I say for sure. Do you know which repairs they’re focusing on and what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t seen the details either — I was hoping you might know. If you hear back, just let me know; I’m happy to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking — the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on — I just haven’t spotted the setup yet. I’ll keep checking near the school pickup route and let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — just wanted to confirm. Please let me know if you spot it near the school pickup route.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Cleo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any extra screws, duct tape, or small tools if you’ve got them? The repair drive’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring whatever extra screws, duct tape, and small tools I have for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Bo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly just your guidance on what’s needed most and where to start. If you’ve got a priority list, I can jump in there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m mostly hearing it’s still on for this weekend, with folks bringing tools and spare parts. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I’ll bring by the chair leg and a couple of loose hinges, if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s perfectly fine — bring them by this weekend and we’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll let you know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. The repair drive is still Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep sharing the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll sort the donations by type and spread the word to a few more neighbors, too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s great, Rey. I’ll head to my shed and see what useful tools I can bring over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Oren. I’ll get the donations sorted and ask a few neighbors about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the repair-drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s this Sunday at the community center, and we’re mostly fixing up small household stuff and a few bikes. I can bring some basic tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps—could you also tell me what time it starts, and whether there’s a specific list of items to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Right now, the biggest help is spreading the word and getting supplies organized—if you can share the latest details, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can spread the word and help organize the supplies. Just send me the latest details and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been a busy one already—folks are really turning out for the repair drive. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great to hear it’s getting good turnout—keep me posted, and I’ll keep spreading the word and pointing folks to the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely—I’ll keep passing along anything urgent I hear. Thanks for helping point folks to the supplies!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many stops are we doing in total?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have the final stop count yet, Mina — I’m still gathering that. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive later.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, then give me the route as soon as you have it so I can plan the drive time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia — could you help sort the donations by type?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help sort them, but I still need the route and final stop count first so I can plan the drive time. How many stops are we expecting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I don’t have the final stop count yet. I’ll check and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: If you’ve got the latest list, I can help spread it around the block. Just tell me what items and drop-off times I should share.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — please share that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m still waiting on the latest item list and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell everyone it’s Sunday at the community center and that the item list and drop-off times are still coming.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, it’s still on — it just moved to Sunday at the community center. I can keep an eye out for extra volunteers if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’ve got it as Sunday at the community center now. I’ll keep an eye on the route and update you if I spot any changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll ask around for a few more volunteers while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — I haven’t seen any change, but I might’ve missed an update. If you want, I can check in and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you check and let me know? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone.
